title: Suggestion reconciliation API, two-phase commit for safe roll-forward/rollback, and webhook delivery guarantees for Optimize
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Goal: Ship a robust, auditable API surface and SDK helpers so Optimize automation can safely apply batching/caching recommendations with guaranteed rollback and predictable webhook delivery semantics.

Scope:
- Server endpoints for suggestion lifecycle: propose, prepare, confirm, abort, reconcile. These endpoints enable a two-phase apply flow so downstream systems (Dedicated control plane, Private agents) can validate applied changes before a commit.
- Reconciliation logic: support proposal reconciliation where the service will compute a deterministic set of concrete config deltas, attach a reconciliation ID, and expose a dry-run diff. Clients must be able to accept or reject reconciled proposals.
- Delivery guarantees for webhooks: at-least-once delivery with deduplication tokens, explicit replay window, and a webhook ack model. SDK will provide helpers that track delivery receipts and backoff on transient failures.
- Safety: all commit operations are append-only with auditable event IDs and reversible rollback handles. Rollbacks must be automated if downstream validation fails or if a manual abort is requested.

Design highlights / API sketch:
- POST /v1/optimize/proposals => creates a raw suggestion (body includes suggested batching/cache profile, target route/model, proposed window). Returns proposal_id and reconciliation_preview_url.
- POST /v1/optimize/proposals/{proposal_id}/prepare => server generates reconciled delta and returns prepare_token and a preview diff. Prepare is idempotent when called with the same client_token.
- POST /v1/optimize/proposals/{proposal_id}/commit => commits the prepared delta. Requires prepare_token and client_token. Commit is guarded by optimistic concurrency: if a newer active reconciliation exists the commit fails with HTTP 409 and a reconcile_hint.
- POST /v1/optimize/proposals/{proposal_id}/abort => aborts a prepared proposal and creates a rollback record.
- GET /v1/optimize/reconciliations/{reconcile_id} => fetch reconciliation status, audit trail, and rollback handle.
- Webhooks: subscription model where events are delivered with headers X-Opt-Event, X-Opt-Dedup-Id, and X-Opt-Replay-Window. Receiving clients should respond 2xx for success; non-2xx triggers retries with exponential backoff and jitter. SDK includes automatic dedup and optional persistent ack store for exactly-once processing semantics at the client side.

Acceptance criteria:
1) Endpoints implemented and covered by unit + e2e tests showing prepare->commit->rollback cycle.
2) SDK helpers for Node/Python expose: propose(), prepare(), commit(), abort(), subscribeWebhooks(), with clear retry/dedup behaviors.
3) Webhook delivery documented with sample server code and integration test that simulates duplicate deliveries and replay.
4) Observability: metrics emitted (optimize.proposals.created, prepare.success, commit.latency, webhook.retries) and traces linkable to reconciliation_id.
5) Security: prepare/commit/abort endpoints require scoped tokens; audit log entries written to customer tenancy; security review completed.

Non-goals: automatic machine-triggered application without human-in-the-loop for high-risk changes during MVP; CSP-specific tooling (will come later).
comments: 2025-01-15 — Ticket created by Asha with initial design sketch and API sketches. Linked to project doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPT/Suggestion+Reconciliation

2025-01-22 — Design review with PM/Infra (Liam O'Connor, Sara Morales). Decided to prefer a prepare/commit flow over a single idempotent apply to make previews and approvals explicit. PM requested clearer rollback telemetry.

2025-01-28 — Security review kickoff (requested by security). Discussed scoped tokens for commit and requirement to write customer audit events to the tenancy. Action: include encryption-in-transit checklist and token scoping in API gateway config. Owner: Marco.

2025-01-31 — Implementation started. Created feature branch and draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/optimize/pull/432. Initial schema for prepare_token and reconciliation_id implemented in service layer.

2025-02-04 — UX/PM feedback: require a clearer human-readable preview URL in prepare response so Console can render diffs. Added reconciliation_preview_url to API. Also add 'risk_score' field to proposals for lightweight gating.

2025-02-06 — Integration tests added for webhook replay: simulate 3 duplicate deliveries, ensure SDK dedup store prevents double-apply. Test located in repo under /tests/integration/webhook_replay_test.py

2025-02-08 — Current blockers: needing infra changes to webhook retry queue (ENG-28911) and a small runtime kernel to expose reconciliation metrics. Working with infra to provision topic and retry policy. Targeting release optimize-2025.02.
